problem.title: Substring With Concatenation of All Words
problem.problemStatement: You are given a string S and an array of words, where every word has the same length. Find all starting indices of substrings in S that are formed by concatenating every word exactly once and without any intervening characters. The words may appear in any order.
problem.input: • First line contains string S. • Second line contains integer M. • Third line contains M space-separated words.
problem.output: • Print all valid starting indices in increasing order. If none exist, print -1.
problem.constraints: • 1 ≤ |S| ≤ 2 × 10^5 • 1 ≤ M ≤ 5000 • All words have equal length.
